page.overview:
Who is MacIntyre?

Admiral MacIntyre was a flag officer at Starfleet Command.

In an alternate timeline, he asked Harry Kim to marry his daughter, due to his fame at having returned home from the Delta Quadrant. Kim later sought out his help in trying to locate the , which was destroyed in the process. MacIntyre, however, was one of many officials in Starfleet who refused to help him. ()
